name: create_dayflow_ticket
description: Create and propose a ticket to the user with explicit ticket fields.

inputs.name: ticket_kind
inputs.description: Strict UI kind. Must be one of: notify, decision, advice.

inputs.name: suggestion_type
inputs.description: Suggestion subtype for dedupe and analytics.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Short title shown to the user.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Main suggestion message shown to the user.

inputs.name: action_type
inputs.description: Action key to run if the user accepts.

inputs.name: trigger_context
inputs.description: Structured context that explains why this ticket was created.

inputs.name: trigger_reason
inputs.description: Short natural language reason for the trigger.

inputs.name: valid_hours
inputs.description: How long the ticket remains valid.

inputs.name: status_effect
inputs.description: Status effect tags associated with this suggestion.

inputs.name: speak_tts
inputs.description: Whether to publish a TTS user message.
